# @digitransit-search-util/digitransit-search-util-distance

<!-- Generated by documentation.js. Update this documentation by updating the source code. -->

## distance

Calculates distance between two points.

### Parameters

*   `latlon1` **[Object][1]** object containing lat, lon values
*   `latlon2` **[Object][1]** object containing lat, lon values

### Examples

```javascript
const latlon1 = {
lat: 3,
lon: 2,
};
const latlon2 = {
lat: 4,
lon: 1,
};
digitransit-util.distance(latlon1, latlon2);
//=157105.77709637067
```

Returns **[Number][2]** distance between two points

[1]: https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Object

[2]: https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Number

### Installation

Install this module individually:

```sh
$ npm install @digitransit-search-util/digitransit-search-util-distance
```

Or install the digitransit-search-util module that includes it as a function:

